notes.title: Gravity Block 2 is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38707580/26770bfd07702452334a83e6c7867d3209f4e1bc.png[/img]

We are very excited to announce that Gravity Block 2 has just been released. After about 4 years, we are back, bringing with us the sequel to our first game, Gravity Block.

Gravity Block 2 is a minimalist puzzle game where you must control the environment to guide the Block to the finish. Featuring new challenges and much harder than its predecessor, Gravity Block 2 offers 50 hand-designed levels, ranging from simple ones to those that will make you cry.

You can get Gravity Block 2 with a 40% launch discount until January 2nd.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3278230/Gravity_Block_2/

You can also purchase the Gravity Block bundle, which includes both games, with a 15% discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47262/

A big thank you to all Gravity Block players and future players of Gravity Block 2. Stay tuned as we’ll soon share more news about the future of Atthus Games.

Have fun!

notes.title: 11 New Levels and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we released our first update in Gravity Block.

We received feedbacks from players this weekend and with that we made bug fixes. 

We also took the opportunity to add new levels. In this update we inserted 11 new levels and their respective achievements!

Thanks to all who are supporting us!

PS.: If you like our game, don't forget to give us a review. Thanks again!

notes.title: Gravity Block is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38707580/207ff2443d4f6136ba9da2a9226b20d08c560427.png[/img]

We’re very excited to say that today we released the early access version of Gravity Block.

If you like puzzle games, do not hesitate to acquire this game.

And better than that, by participating in Early Access you can choose the future of our game, and help us add new levels and features.

Get your copy of Gravity Block now, and if you like, leave us a comment:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1417540/Gravity_Block/

Have fun!
